title: journey-qa independent persona session
description: personas/<persona-id>/session.json: what one independent persona session was given and what it ran on. runners/explore/merge_findings.py refuses sessions that share a session_id or a browser_profile, and sessions that share an instance without saying why.

persona.description: Roster people[].id; the name of the session directory.

session_id.description: Opaque id of the agent session. Unique per persona: two personas in one agent session are not independent.

browser_profile.description: Name of the browser profile, context or task space this session used, never a path. Unique per persona: a shared profile shares logins, cookies and history.

instance.description: Id of the environment instance the session ran against.

shared_instance_reason.description: Why this session shares its instance with another one. Required on every session that shares; a shared instance means one persona's actions can become another's starting state.

inputs.description: Everything the session was given. Nothing else may reach it.

profile.description: Roster person id the brief was built from. Equals persona.

docs.description: Entry point of the public documentation (a URL or a run-relative path).
